scripts.pilot:audit: pnpm run compile-cli && node dist/cli.js audit
scripts.pilot:draft: pnpm run compile-cli && node dist/cli.js draft
scripts.pilot:report: pnpm run compile-cli && node dist/cli.js report
scripts.pilot:score: pnpm run compile-cli && node dist/cli.js score
scripts.pilot:validate: pnpm run compile-cli && node dist/cli.js validate
scripts.compile-cli: pnpm --filter @swarm/database build && pnpm --filter @swarm/discovery build && pnpm --workspace-root exec tsc -p packages/pilot/tsconfig.json
